textwithimage.text:
Intel® Core™ (7. Generation) 7000E Serie ("Kaby Lake-H")

The TQ TQMx70EB is a high-performance COM Express® Basic Type 6 module, designed to meet the demanding requirements of advanced computing and graphics applications. Powered by 7th Generation Intel® Core™ and Intel® Xeon® E3-1500 v6 series processors, codenamed Kaby Lake-H, this module delivers exceptional processing power. It supports up to 32 GB of DDR4 memory with optional ECC protection, ensuring efficient multitasking and data integrity.

One of the standout features of the TQMx70EB is its robust graphics capabilities. Equipped with the Intel® GT2 graphics controller, it supports up to three independent displays with 4K resolution at 60 Hz, providing immersive visual experiences. Additionally, the module features hardware-accelerated 10-bit HEVC and VP9 encoding/decoding for premium multimedia content.

Connectivity is a breeze with this module, boasting large bandwidth through up to 24 PCIe lanes (Gen 3), including a PCIe x16 PEG port. It also supports Intel® Optane™ 3D XPoint SSDs, further enhancing storage performance.

Engineered for reliability, the TQMx70EB includes a TQMx86 board controller with custom expansion options (flexiCFG), watchdog functionality, thermal management, and a power-efficient "Green ECO-Off" mode. With its optimized performance, this COM Express® module is well-suited for a range of applications, including medical, gaming, and industrial systems, where high-end computing and graphics performance are essential.

Experience the future of embedded computing with the TQMx70EB from TQ Systems, designed in partnership with Intel.

text.text:
Features

  • Intel® Core™ and Xeon® Processor Support: 7th Generation processors for robust computing power.
  • Exceptional Graphics Performance: Intel® GT2 graphics controller with 4K resolution and 10-bit HEVC/VP9 support.
  • High Bandwidth Connectivity: Up to 24 PCIe lanes (Gen 3) and PCIe x16 PEG port for rapid data transfer.
  • Memory Flexibility: Support for up to 32 GB of DDR4 memory with optional ECC protection.
  • Energy Efficiency: "Green ECO-Off" mode for minimal standby power consumption.

table.text:
CPU
  • Intel® Xeon® E3-1500 v6 series (Kaby Lake-H)
  • Xeon E3-1505L v6 (4x 2.2/3.0 GHz, 8 MB, 25 W)
  • Intel® Core™ 7000E series (Kaby Lake-H)
  • Core i7-7820EQ (4x 3.0/3.7 GHz, 8 MB, 45/35 W)
  • Core i5-7440EQ (4x 2.9/3.6 GHz, 6 MB, 45/35W)
  • Core i5-7442EQ (4x 2.1/2.9 GHz, 6 MB, 25 W)
  • Core i3-7100E (2x 2.9, 3 MB, 35 W)
  • Core i3-7102EQ (2x 2.1 GHz, 3 MB, 25 W)
Memory
  • DDR4 - up to 32GB, 2 SO-DIMMs
  • EEPROM - 32kbit
Graphics
  • 3x Digital Display Interface/DP++ with up to 4K @ 60 Hz for DP 1.2a/HDMI 1.4 with multi stream transport (MST)
  • Intel® Quick Sync Video and Wireless Display support
  • LVDS Interface (18/24-bit, Single/Dual Channel) / (optional eDP 1.4 with 4 lanes instead of LVDS)
Communications Interfaces
  • USB - 4x USB 3.0 | 8x USB 2.o
  • Serial Port - 2x Serial port
Other Interfaces
  • PCIe - 8x PCIe Gen 3
  • LPC - LPC/eSPI
  • I2C
  • SMBus
  • SPI - SPI (for external UEFI BIOS flash)
  • Audio - 1x Intel HD Audio
  • GPIO - 8x GPIO 
  • SATA - 4x SATA Gen 3
General
  • Dimensions - 125mm x 95mm
  • Plug-in System - COM Express Basic, type 6
  • Temperature range - Standard temperature: 0°C…+60°C 
  • Power supply - 8.5 V - 20 V / 5 V Standby (optional) / 3 V battery/GoldCAP on carrier (optional)
  • Power consumption - Power: typ. 25-30 W/max. 60 W (Green ECO-Off: < 0.1 W)
